s.add(Not(And(isquic, Not(alpn_in))))

# !(isquic && tfo)
s.add(Not(And(isquic, tfo)))

# !(isdtls && tfo)  -- isdtls not provided; keep as uninterpreted bool
isdtls = Bool('isdtls')
s.add(Not(And(isdtls, tfo)))

# !(dane_tlsa_rrset != NULL)  ->  dane_tlsa_rrset is NULL
s.add(Not(dane_tlsa_rrset))

# !(dane_tlsa_domain != NULL) || !(tlsa_import_rrset(con, dane_tlsa_rrset) <= 0)
# i.e. dane_tlsa_domain is NULL OR tlsa_import_rrset succeeds

# !(dane_tlsa_domain != NULL) || !(dane_tlsa_rrset == NULL)
s.add(Or(Not(dane_tlsa_domain), dane_tlsa_rrset))

# !(dane_tlsa_domain != NULL) || !(SSL_dane_enable(con, dane_tlsa_domain) <= 0)

# !(!noservername && (servername != NULL || dane_tlsa_domain == NULL))

         Not(And(servername, Not(SSL_set_tlsext_host_name(servername))))))

# !(sess_in != NULL) || !(!SSL_set_session(con, sess))

# !(sess_in != NULL) || !(sess == NULL)
s.add(Or(Not(sess_in), sess))

# !(sess_in != NULL) || !(stmp == NULL)
s.add(Or(Not(sess_in), stmp))

# !(enable_server_rpk) || !(!SSL_set1_server_cert_type(...))

# !(enable_client_rpk) || !(!SSL_set1_client_cert_type(...))
